item.title: Decisions and Dollars: How App Companies Survive the AI Agent Era
item.description: Seat-based SaaS pricing weakens when AI agents run workflows. Durable software companies capture user edit histories (decisions) and payment flows (dollars).

item.title: Building a Personal Quant Trading System with LLMs and TimesFM
item.description: How retail engineers combine Google’s TimesFM time-series foundation model, multi-agent LLMs, MCP, and Polars to run lean quant trading pipelines.

item.title: Embedding AI as Core Organizational Infrastructure
item.description: How a payment fintech company turns personal AI experiments into shared infrastructure through hackathons, study clubs, onboarding, and team evangelists.

item.title: Emotion-Free Momentum Quant Trading with the Toss Securities API and LLMs
item.description: Building an emotion-free Korean stock momentum bot that pairs a fintech brokerage Open API with LLMs and 3 years of AMQS backtest logs.

item.title: Open-Source AI Quant Trading Strategy and Semiconductor Stock Signal Bot
item.description: An open-source release of an AI quant trading strategy and semiconductor stock buy/sell signal bot stabilized over three years of backtesting.

item.title: Comparing Open-Source Financial AI Projects
item.description: A technical comparison of TradingAgents, OpenBB, Qlib, FinGPT, AI-Trader, FinRL, RD-Agent, and FinRobot across data, models, and agent workflows.

item.title: Toss Securities Launches Open API for Automated Trading and AI Analysis
item.description: Toss Securities enters retail algorithmic trading with a web-standard REST and WebSocket Open API, external LLM integration, and zero domestic fees.

item.title: A Fintech Company's Experiment in Becoming an AI-Native Organization
item.description: How a global fintech company cut 40% of its workforce, flattened reporting layers, and modeled internal data to operate around AI.

item.title: Korea Investment & Securities AI Extensions: Strategy, Backtest, and Orders
item.description: How Korea Investment & Securities structures its AI agent extensions with 10 strategy presets, MCP backtesting, and human-in-the-loop order execution.
